_comment: What a province has on its land, and where. Engine data, not a campaign's: every realm works the same ground. A site with 'masons' is the one place people are put to work that produces no store at all: the walls. A site with a 'works' is a place people are put to work — its plaque carries the count and the two buttons that move hands onto it, and 'works' names which industry the engine counts it as. A site with a 'room' opens a screen of its own when its name is pressed; a site with both does both. 'spot' is where it stands on assets/city/town.png, in that picture's own proportions, 'scale' is how tall it stands, as a fraction of the picture, for a drawing that wants its own size. The art for it is assets/city/buildings/<key>.png, dropped in whenever it is drawn. A site whose picture has a moving part carries a 'rotor': the sheet is assets/city/buildings/<key>-rotor.png, 'at' is where its frame sits on the base in the base's own pixels, 'frame' is one frame's size, and the rest is how it is played — until then the plaque stands on bare ground. 'site' names the industry a province must actually have for it to exist at all: there is no quarry where there is no stone. Stone and iron are the same ground worked two ways and no province holds both, so the quarry and the mine stand on one spot and the province decides which of them is there. The ruined field is not a site at all: it stands on the land only in a summer whose crop is gone, which is the one thing here the province's own year decides rather than its land.

buildings.name: Farms
buildings.blurb: What the province eats, sown in spring and reaped in autumn.

buildings.name: Castle
buildings.blurb: The walls the province shelters behind, and what it takes to raise them.

buildings.name: Lumber
buildings.blurb: Every wall, shaft and bow stave in the province starts in this yard.

buildings.name: Cattle
buildings.blurb: Milk and cheese every season, and meat when the granary fails.

buildings.name: Idle
buildings.blurb: Hands with nowhere to be. Every one of them is a season wasted.

buildings.name: Fields
buildings.blurb: Turned earth between one crop and the next. When the water takes a sowing, this is where the hands go to put it right.

buildings.name: Quarry
buildings.blurb: Cut stone, for the walls that timber will no longer answer for.

buildings.name: Iron Mine
buildings.blurb: Ore out of the hill, and the arms and hinges it is beaten into.

buildings.name: Blacksmith
buildings.blurb: Iron and wood into arms, a commission at a time.
